_why: The report-file channel exists to rescue a review whose verdict rode the agent's LAST MESSAGE and was lost. `score` then read `--review` FIRST and returned 2 on OSError, so the rescue was refused at the door in the one case it was built for: an ABSENT `--out` (a dispatch killed before `_write_out_atomic` ran, report already on disk) failed the cycle while an EMPTY `--out` scored the same report fine. Two spellings of the same fact, opposite branches. The mutations attack the ORDER and both of its failure directions -- reading the review first again, and softening the refusal so a cycle with nothing readable on either channel scores anyway. Every one leaves a run that still prints a verdict-shaped ARCHREVIEW line. (The empty-file-is-authoritative direction is NOT duplicated here: archreview_report_file_channel.json::an-empty-report-file-is-authoritative already owns that exact find/replace/test, and two specs mutating one line is a false count of coverage, not more of it.)

mutations.name: the-review-is-read-before-the-report-channel
mutations._mechanism: The defect restored, as an early read that still returns 2. A complete report file sits unread and the cycle is refused with `UNREADABLE reason=review:FileNotFoundError` -- and because that IS a real token with a real reason, the operator reads it as a finding about the dispatch rather than as this gate declining to look at the channel it was given.

mutations.name: an-unreadable-review-stops-being-fatal
mutations._mechanism: The over-correction, and the reason the fix had to be an ordering change rather than a softened guard. Swallow the OSError and a cycle with NOTHING readable on either channel scores anyway: `review` is empty string, no ASSESSMENT is found, and the run reports NO_VERDICT -- a statement about what the reviewer said, when the truth is that this gate never managed to read it. A cannot-judge rendered as a judgement.

mutations.name: a-verdictless-report-file-still-wins
mutations._mechanism: Non-empty becomes sufficient again. A write killed part-way leaves real prose and no verdict line; preferring it DISCARDS a last message that carried one, and the cycle reports NO_VERDICT about a review that in fact returned one. This gap only became reachable when the file started winning over an unreadable review -- the same commit that made the channel work made an incomplete file authoritative.
